name: Prospecting!
creator: Prospecting!
redeem: Open Prospecting! on Roblox and wait for your character to load in by the river.
Click the Settings gear button at the top of the screen.
Find the Enter Code box in the Settings menu and type the code in lowercase, exactly as shown.
Press Claim to get your Cash, Meteor Shards, and boosts.
notes:
Prospecting! is a gold panning game from the Prospecting! Group. You scoop dirt into your pan, shake it out in the river, and find gold, gems, and rare minerals that you sell for cash. That cash buys better pans, shovels, and gear, and new areas like caves and old mining sites hold rarer finds. Sluices keep working while you are away, so you can still earn a little offline.

Codes give Cash, Meteor Shards, and timed boosts such as 2x Luck or a Sell Boost. The 2x Luck boost is the most valuable because it raises your chances of rare finds, so redeem it right before a long panning session. New codes usually come with updates, visit milestones, and holiday events, and the developers post them in the official Discord and the Roblox group.

faq.q: Where do I enter codes in Prospecting!?
faq.a: Click the Settings gear at the top of the screen. The Enter Code box is inside that menu, and you press Claim after typing the code.

faq.q: When should I redeem a luck code like delay?
faq.a: Claim it when you have time for a long session, since the boost is timed. delay gives 2x Luck for 3 hours, the longest boost on the current list.
It was tied to an egg hunt event and expired after it ended. Seasonal and event codes in Prospecting! usually stop working once the event is over.

tips: Look at the stats on each pan and shovel before you buy. Upgrade both over time instead of putting all your cash into just one.
Sell your finds regularly so you always have cash coming in for the next gear upgrade.
Stay at the first river until you can afford better gear. Rushing into new areas with starter tools makes each trip slow.
The game says there are secrets to discover, so explore the rivers, caves and old mining sites instead of panning in one spot forever.
useRewards: Spend code Cash on a better pan or shovel, since gear is what speeds up every trip. For oneyear, pan for a while without selling, then redeem it and sell your whole haul under the 1.5x Sell Boost. Keep panning with its 2x Luck for the rest of the two hours. Hold Meteor Shards until you know what you want from them, and redeem luck codes one at a time.
